analysis.summary: Thangamayil Jewellery Limited reported a significant organic revenue growth of 73% in FY 2025-26, driven largely by newly operated Chennai retail outlets. EBITDA reached Rs. 57,674 lakhs and PAT improved to Rs. 35,165 lakhs. The overall live customer base increased to 45 lakhs, and the management recommended a dividend of Rs.

guidance.claim: The company plans to nearly double the top line in the next four years.
guidance.quote: Plan to nearly double the top line in the next four years that took us 25 years to be where we are now.

guidance.claim: The customer base is slated to increase to 40 Lakhs by March 31, 2026.
guidance.quote: Excellent Customer base built over period of years up to 32 Lakhs numbers and slated to increase to 40 Lakhs by 31/03/26

guidance.claim: The company targets to improve the gross profit margin from 9.64% to 10% on price rationalization.
guidance.quote: • Improve the gross profit margin from 9.64% to 10% on price rationalisation.

guidance.claim: Management targets Same Store Sales (SSS) improvement by at least 10% over and above the current level.
guidance.quote: • SSS improvement at least by 10% over and above current level.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that the overall size of the market in volume terms is shrinking modestly while unhealthy competition prevails.
demand_outlook.quote: Continued unhealthy competition prevailing in the market as the over all size of the market in volume terms shrinking modestly.

margins_costs.claim: The gross profit margin was reported at 8.76% for the year 2024-25.
The company took a customs duty hit of 1,547 lakhs in the second quarter of the 24-25 financial year.
margins_costs.quote: Above all, customs duty hit of 1,547 lakhs taken in the second quarter of 24-25 FY also aff ected the overall PBT by that amount.

orders_capacity.claim: Total operational retail space exceeded 1,00,000 sq.ft in February 2025.
orders_capacity.quote: Maximum operational Retail space exceeded 1,00,000 sq.ft (February 2025)

orders_capacity.claim: Retail space increased by 17.46% to reach 104,000 sq ft.
orders_capacity.quote: Retail Space (increases by 17.46%) 104000 sq ft 88000 sq ft 18%

orders_capacity.claim: All 60 existing retail outlets are operating above the break-even point level.
orders_capacity.quote: All the existing 60 retail outlets are operating above the BEP level with adequate Margin of safety

capital_allocation.claim: Out of the Rs. 50,776 lakhs net sum from the Rights issue, only a sum of Rs. 2,924 lakhs remained unutilized as on May 14, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: Out of the said sum of 50,776 lakhs only a sum of 2,924 lakhs remaining unutilized as on 14/05/25, All the formalities governing the monitoring of the utilisation of the funds collected are complied with.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of 6 per share on a face value of 10, bringing total distribution to 10 per share for FY24.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Board after considering the funding requirements for 2024-25 both for capex and enlarged working capital requirements due to gold price increase by 12%, has recommended a final dividend of ` 6/- per share of face value of Rs.10/- aggregating to Rs.10/- per share as total distribution of dividend for the financial year 2023-24 on the doubled equity capital.

risks_headwinds.claim: The vertical rise in gold price restricts sales because customers are uncertain about price sustenance.
risks_headwinds.quote: The adverse impact on vertical rise in gold price restricts the sale by the company as customers are not sure about the sustenance of price
